diagnosis: For the unprimed theorem, no bump-function argument is needed: the test function f itself may be substituted for g. The resulting integral of the nonnegative continuous function x ↦ ⟪f x, f x⟫_ℝ is zero, hence that function vanishes everywhere and therefore f = 0. The reported errors occur in the separate primed theorem, outside the designated proof body.
proof_body:
by
  have hf' := hg f hf
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg] at hf'
  · rw [Continuous.ae_eq_iff_eq] at hf'
    · funext x
      have hf'' := congrFun hf' x
      simpa using hf''
    · have hf : Continuous f := hf.smooth.continuous
      fun_prop
    · fun_prop
  · intro x
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
    apply real_inner_self_nonneg'
  · apply IsTestFunction.integrable
    exact IsTestFunction.inner hf hf
